data.title: Will APT’s price clear $0.87 after Aptos’s launch of Block-STM v2 upgrade?
data.description:
Aptos [APT] rebounded by over 13% in 24 hours as the wider market recovered. Altcoins took the lead on this recovery as the total market cap of all cryptos surpassed $2.77 trillion, up by more than 2.21%.

At the time of writing, APT’s daily trading volume was $100 million, primarily driven by the hype around the upgrade of the ecosystem. What are the final details of the update though?

Aptos Labs announces upgrade as network reacts

Aptos Labs announced the upgrade of Block-STM, which has been running in parallel on Aptos since the mainnet. This upgrade was completed on 15th October and was named Block-STM v2, with other chains building on it.

This upgrade has since increased transaction throughput and scalability. In fact, this process was explained by Aptos Labs’ Head of Research Alexander Spiegelman and Near Protocol [NEAR] co-founder Illia Polosukhin.

As a result, the throughput and network activity responded instantly. For instance, the chain’s TPS hit a peak value of 1,308 while the real-time throughput was 174. This revealed that there was a difference between the theoretical and real values.

Additionally, Daily Active Accounts rose from 46,670 to 49,385, a 5.82% uptick.

As a result, the monthly total of active accounts hit a peak of 710,712, with still 16 days to go before the end of October. New Accounts Created also grew from 4,098 to 4,395.

User transactions also followed suit with a rise of more than 1.335 million in a single day. That is, 9.575 million transactions compared to 10.91 million the following day.

Why are bulls struggling to break resistance level?

However, on the 4-hour chart, APT’s price was rising but facing a huge blockade at $0.8777. Every time the price hit this level, it got rejected and even had a fake breakout five days ago.

At press time, APT was trading above $0.8777, with the same faintly flipping the SuperTrend indicator to bullish. Still, it wasn’t confirmation if the altcoin’s bulls can keep it out of this consolidation.

This may be why the RSI Divergence has been bearish. However, it broke above the neutral level with a reading of 62.41.

Therefore, the sustained APT uptrend could face rejection at $0.9653, a level that triggered a sharp drop to $0.7620. If buyers keep charging, the altcoin may reclaim $1 now that a network upgrade is in place and is boosting activity.

Final Summary

  • APT rallied by over 13% after Aptos Labs announced a network upgrade to Block-STM v2. 
  • APT broke above the $0.8777 resistance level, with bulls now targeting $1.

data.title: Bitcoin price prediction — Relief reversal ahead or deeper $80K flush?
data.description:
A week ago, the CME FedWatch Tool revealed a 17.7% probability of a 25bps interest rate hike during 28th October’s FOMC meeting. At the time of writing, that probability had risen to 27.7%.

Bitcoin’s [BTC] funding rates on Binance fell to -0.0073%, reported crypto analyst Darkfost. Negative funding rates revealed that a majority of market participants were positioned bearishly.

The last time this happened was in June, when Bitcoin’s price was around $62K. Here, it’s also worth noting that the analyst drew attention to the negative macroeconomic news that both the CPI and PPI data came in hot earlier this week.

It contributed to the rising rate hike odds, with Bitcoin in the middle of a correction towards $80K too.

A closer look at BTC derivatives data

News that inflation had accelerated to 3.7% year-on-year in September, up from 3.4% in August and higher than the 3.6% market expectations, led to a Bitcoin price slide to $80.3K.

And yet, the 24-hour growth in Open Interest, denominated in BTC, rose from -3.0% to 4.6%.

The analyst also found that across all exchanges, the funding rates had been slightly positive during the price drop. Rising OI during a price slide highlighted that more market participants were willing to use leverage. It also underlined the risk for long positions if the price continues to fall.

Delta growth rate points to potential for Bitcoin recovery

Now, while the funding rate was negative, showing a bearish bias, it is at moments when the market consensus seems to be one way that a trend reversal tends to happen.

The Delta Growth Rate metric combines the market cap and realized cap growth to combine BTC’s price accumulation and the accumulation of onchain value. Negative values show potential undervaluation and weaker speculative activity.

The metric has been negative all year. However, it has shown signs of improving in recent weeks, according to crypto intelligence platform Alphractal.

It was not enough to signal a structural trend reversal, but it did point to improving market dynamics. It remains to be seen if Bitcoin’s correction towards $80K is over and if buyers will step in to keep the momentum going.

Final Summary

  • Bitcoin funding rates on Binance were negative, spurred by negative inflation news and rising rate hike odds.
  • The Delta Growth metric, which was still negative, has managed to push higher in recent weeks to signal improving market dynamics.

data.title: Tether backs Saber Money’s payment expansion across Asia and the Gulf
data.description:
Saber Money, which facilitates international payments in stablecoins, has accepted investments from both Tether and CMCC Global’s Titan Fund. Saber announced the funding on October 14 without disclosing the amount or either investor’s ownership stake.

That money will fuel expansion across Asia-Pacific and the Gulf, including local license and banking partnerships.

Funding targets local payment access

Saber mentions wanting to expand into the business payments arena, including supplier bills and moving money internationally for companies.

In addition, it has existing routes which it says it will strengthen.

For businesses, the practical question is whether a service can deliver payments in the currency and location a recipient needs.

A supplier awaiting a bank deposit, for example, needs more than a completed stablecoin transfer. Currency conversion, local banking access, and compliance checks remain part of the process.

Saber reports growth, but details remain limited

In the past nine months, Saber’s payment volumes grew more than six times. In addition, it reports that it processes billions of dollars in payments in more than 40 countries, and that more than 90% of all of its payments are processed in under one minute. This information has been provided by the company itself.

The announcement does not provide an exact payment-volume total or explain how it measures processing time.

What the investment means for Tether

In Tether’s case, Saber represents another investment in a company that seeks everyday payment opportunities with stablecoins.

Whether the funding produces wider access or lower costs will depend on implementation. New payment routes, completed approvals, and clearly measured customer outcomes would offer stronger evidence than the investment announcement alone.

Final Summary

  • There was no information as to how much capital Tether and the Titan Fund invested, but it is believed that the funds will be used to expedite Saber Money’s planned expansion across Asia-Pacific and the Gulf countries.
  • Saber will apply for various licenses and sign with numerous bank partners on its path to expansion.

data.title: Why NEAR crypto’s 12% rally could extend after Sunrise partnership
data.description:
NEAR prices have risen in response to Sunrise and Near Intent’s partnership to establish liquid markets for NEAR Intents assets on Solana, as announced in their recent tweet. Over the last 24 hours alone, the token has gained more than 12%.

Moreover, the partnership could expose NEAR to a broader trading audience by making the token accessible within Solana’s [SOL] ecosystem.

With fresh market access and investment flows supporting the bullish bias, can NEAR extend its bullish run?

How is NEAR market activity reacting to the news?

Notably, the development arrives as trading activity picks up in the Futures market and retail traders increase their participation across the spot markets.

Solana Compass reported approximately $11.4 million in 24-hour trading volume for NEAR on Solana on launch day, alongside about $819K in netflow.

The coin’s derivative data shows that NEAR Intent revenue has skyrocketed to $163K, not been recorded over the past three months. This being just the beginning the token revenue could be key for the token’s anticipated bullish run continuation.

Notably, NEAR ETFs reported $1.13 million in daily inflows, indicating that investors are still allocating capital to NEAR-linked products during the period. Moreover, persistent inflows could support demand, although a single session cannot establish a lasting trend.

Will NEAR crypto’s bullish run prevail?

On the daily chart, the impacts of the development are evident. NEAR’s price action is currently gaining momentum from a key demand zone. The token’s bullish gains are going hand in hand with its trading volume, with its prices now trading above all key EMAs.

All in all, with the partnership and ETF inflow surge, NEAR projected rally continuation could occur. However, traders and investors should be aware of the bearish caution from a potential profit-taking phase among the holders and bulls on floating profits.

Final Summary

  • NEAR’s Sunrise partnership opens a new route into Solana markets.
  • Reported ETF inflows of $1.13 million and rising trading activity could support the rally if buying pressure persists.

data.title: Top 9 decentralized exchanges of October 2026
data.description:
Decentralized exchanges execute trades without any intermediaries and offer users enhanced privacy. Centralized exchanges are more regulated and are easier to navigate for new users. Decentralized exchanges provide users with complete control of their assets and are non-custodial in nature.

Here is our list of the top 9 decentralized exchanges of October 2026:

1. Raydium 

Raydium is one of Solana’s most popular decentralized exchanges and liquidity protocols. It is a one-stop solution for swapping tokens, providing liquidity, launching tokens through LaunchLab, and accessing Raydium Preps. It connects with OpenBook’s main trading system, thereby helping provide more funds for trades and sharing activity across the Solana ecosystem.

Unlike traditional AMMs, which depend on liquidity pools for matching trades, Raydium’s integration with OpenBook allows access to a broader pool of liquidity and offers better pricing for users.

2. Hyperliquid

Hyperliquid aims to make finance open, credible, and transparent. It is a Layer-1 platform built for perpetual futures and spot trading and focuses on perpetual contracts. The ecosystem also supports lending, borrowing, and real-world assets.

It also has a full-fledged Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), making it a leading force in the DeFi space. HYPE is the native token of the ecosystem and is used for governance, staking, and payments.

3. Uniswap

Uniswap is a decentralized protocol that uses AMM to enable peer-to-peer trading of digital assets without any intermediaries or central authority. It has a liquidity pool and a developer ecosystem that is useful for users.

The platform handles a lot of trading volume and is one of the main gateways into DeFi trading. It started out on Ethereum but is now available on other networks along with Layer-2 ecosystems.

4. Orca 

A decentralized exchange that lets users earn yield and provide liquidity. It has tools for swapping supported tokens, creating and managing liquidity positions, launching pools, and building with its liquidity infrastructure.

Orca is created to make on-chain trading and liquidity provision accessible through clean interfaces, open infra, and Solana-native tools. It also provides clear tools for token swaps and liquidity provision.

5. PancakeSwap

PancakeSwap is a DEX with an AMM that lets users swap cryptocurrencies without relying on centralized intermediaries. It offers token swaps, liquidity provision, yield farming, limit orders, prediction markets, and a marketplace.

It operates on more than 10 blockchains, including BNB Smart Chain, Base, Polygon, zkSync, Linea, Solana, and Arbitrum. CAKE is the native governance token of the platform and is used for staking and governance.

6. SushiSwap

Starting out as a fork of Uniswap, SushiSwap has turned into a DeFi platform that is very popular for its features. It lets users earn returns on their crypto rather than just trade it. Yield farming is also one of the most popular offerings of the platform.

Additionally, liquidity providers earn a part of the trading fees and also get extra rewards through different pools and farming programs. It also has a community-focused approach, and the SUSHI token helps users participate in decision-making.

7.  Meteora

Built on Solana, Meteora is a liquidity protocol and exchange that acts as a fundamental liquidity infrastructure layer rather than just a consumer-facing decentralized exchange. The platform focuses on solving high slippage and fragmented liquidity issues through its mechanics.

The platform has a Dynamic Liquidity Market Maker or DLMM aspect that allows liquidity providers to concentrate their capital into precise categories rather than spreading it across an infinite range.

8. Osmosis

Osmosis is built on the Cosmos blockchain and was created with cross-chain activity in mind. Users can swap their assets from different Cosmos-based chains without depending on multiple platforms or any complicated workarounds.

The platform has a simple user interface and relatively low transaction costs, and offers quick swaps. Users can access liquidity and assets from over 100 ecosystems and trade up to 30X leverage on Osmosis.

9. CoinEx

Another popular option, CoinEx supports more than 1300 digital assets and gives traders a chance to access both established coins and lesser-known ones. It offers spot and margin trading along with futures markets. This makes it a viable option for traders looking to engage in multiple trading strategies.

There are many features available for users without any KYC; this can be especially great for those who value a greater degree of privacy. Trading fees start at 0.2% with discounts available for holders of the CET token.

Final word

Decentralized exchanges are an essential part of the crypto ecosystem and give users more control and hold over their assets. They can manage how they trade, store, or hold their digital assets. DEXs started out as simple token swap platforms and have now evolved into much more comprehensive ecosystems of their own. With that said, users should always do their own research before committing any funds to these platforms.

data.title: Analyzing STRK’s 15% fall, $2M in long liquidations — What’s next?
data.description:
While the wider market signaled a recovery from the recent sell-offs, Starknet wasn’t so lucky as it struggled under massive bearish pressure. In fact, since facing rejection at $0.12, the altcoin has closed at lower lows on the charts. 

Previously, the altcoin rallied amid speculation as investors turned bullish on its L1 plans for 2027. However, that speculation has since faded.

Over the last 24 hours, for example, STRK breached the $0.07-support, hitting a low of $0.069. At the time of writing, Starknet was trading at around $0.0707, down 15% on the daily charts.

The price drop was accompanied by a 60% decline in volume, indicating a sharp market slowdown as investors stayed away. 

Starknet long liquidations add to selling pressure

This extended decline on Starknet’s charts has seen bulls flushed out, with over $2 million in long positions liquidated.

The long liquidations increased selling pressure, further weakening the market. With liquidation risk remaining high, traders have significantly reduced their exposure too.

In fact, according to CoinGlass, over the last 24 hours, the altcoin has recorded $249 million in Futures outflows.

The selling pressure was even more intense over shorter timeframes. Over eight hours, Futures Netflow dropped to -$3.22 million as $41.98 million flowed out of the Futures market.

Typically, when sellers dominate the derivatives market, selling pressure can increase, resulting in further losses.

Protocol outflows exceed $59 million

In addition to sustained market exits, significant capital has flowed out of the protocol too. 

On 16th October, Protocol USD Inflows fell into negative territory, hitting -$59 million. A negative value alluded to higher outflows as users withdrew funds.

Often, higher protocol outflows could mean a fall in user participation and, in many cases, greater selling pressure too. 

What’s next for STRK?

As it stands, STRK is under pressure from two sides. Derivatives traders have lost confidence in the market, while the protocol is also seeing capital outflows.

As a result, southbound momentum has strengthened significantly. A look at the Relative Strength Index (RSI) seemed to support this bearish outlook too. Since forming a bearish crossover three days ago, the RSI has remained on a downward trajectory, falling to 53.

A falling RSI is indicative of weakening momentum. A drop below 50 would provide further evidence of increasing bearish pressure.

Therefore, if the current selling pressure continues, Starknet is likely to drop to $0.062, with October rally’s starting point at $0.055 acting as critical support.

However, a daily close above $0.075 would invalidate this bearish setup and open a path to reclaim $0.08 in the short term.

Final summary

  • Starknet [STRK] fell by 15%, breaching its $0.07 support, to a low of $0.069. 
  • Starknet saw $2 million in long liquidations, while protocol outflows rose to -$59 million.

data.title: Jupiter tests $0.29 demand zone as Solana DEX token mirrors Bitcoin’s pullback
data.description:
Jupiter’s [JUP] new trading product, YOLO, recorded over $1 billion in volume after its 15h October beta launch. Jupiter’s trading product on Solana offers 1,000x leverage on SOL, BTC, and ETH, and allows trading with as little as $10 to “make it big.”

Traders should remember that at that kind of leverage, a 0.1% price move against their direction could wipe out their position. As a simulated trading model, a single house pool funded by losers pays the winners, and the individual trades don’t make it to a real market, but of course the profits and losses are real.

Winners are paid when the platform’s liquidity pool can cover the entire amount, and there are no earlier claims in the queue.

The impact on JUP price trends

Jupiter’s long-term trend has been bullish since the swing structure break on the daily timeframe in May. The low made at $0.144 was the anchor point for the rally that pushed upwards to $0.388.

Since making this high earlier in October, Jupiter token’s price has declined by 21.8% so far.

The next long-term demand zone to watch will be at $0.22 (cyan), the bullish order block that propelled the latest JUP bullish impulse move.

Do bears have the upper hand?

On the 2-hour chart, the price trend shifted bearishly across the board. The demand zone at $0.32 was flipped to a supply zone too. The retest as resistance in recent days yielded a bearish reaction as well.

The next demand zone at $0.29 was already being tested at the time of writing. Given the wider market weakness due to Bitcoin’s [BTC] retracement towards $80K, it is likely that JUP would continue its descent over the next week.

A drop below $0.275 and a retest of $0.29 would likely offer short-term traders a selling opportunity.

Final Summary

  • The 1,000x Jupiter trading product on Solana recorded over $1 billion in trading volume after its 15th October beta launch.
  • Over the past ten days, JUP’s price has retraced by 21.8% and could slide further next week.

data.title: Why Venice Token’s AI expansion could push VVV price toward $30
data.description:
Venice Token [VVV] continues to advance after a successful bounce off from the $21 support zone, which was previously the resistance level that acted as a barrier against bears. At the time of writing, VVV surged by 10% in  the past 24 hours.

The rise follows the addition of new products with AI technology, namely Hy4 Preview, Muse Spark, and Muse Wonder by Venice. At the same time, VVV’s revenue growth has been aided by increased adoption of its AI solutions, with October generating the most revenue on the platform.

Could solid fundamentals aid VVV in breaking into the $30 liquidity cluster? 

Can VVV defend the $21 support?

VVV’s rebound follows repeated tests of the $21 price zone, which has shifted from resistance into a key support zone for the network bulls.

Remaining above this level will enable the bullish formation to be maintained and also provide the bulls a chance to attack stronger resistance. On the other hand, breaking down below the $21 level will undermine the bullish technical setup.

But with the token still trading above the 50-day, 100-day, and 200-day MAs, VVV’s long-term structure still leans on the favor of bulls. 

Is $30 VVV’s next target?

The next major barrier for the bulls sits around the $30 resistance level. The price level hosts an unmitigated liquidity cluster worth $31 million that could attract market attention, according to the liquidation heat maps data. 

If VVV manages to hold the support and buying activity gains momentum, then it could help the coin move towards this area. Revenue growth and AI product development will likely provide support to sentiment, but traders require further confirmation from the price action itself.

Currently, the focus should be on $21 as breaking below it might complicate the journey towards $30.

Final Summary

  • VVV rebounded from the $21 support zone after repeated tests, with buyers eyeing resistance near $30.
  • Venice Token’s expanding product lineup and reported revenue growth could strengthen sentiment, while a sustained break below $21 would weaken the bullish setup.

data.title: Celestia crypto hits 11-month high – Is $0.80 TIA’s next target?
data.description:
As the broader crypto market recovered, Celestia [TIA] bounced back from a $0.52 slip and reached an 11-month high of $0.71. 

However, at press time, Celestia was trading around $0.68, up 28% on the daily charts. Over the same window, the altcoin’s trading volume surged 160% to $162 million, indicating higher market participation. 

Additionally, the daily turnover rose from $32 million to $63 million, suggesting a higher buying pressure. 

Celestia rallies as bears face liquidation

After Celestia pumped, traders who had positioned themselves anticipating further price slip were flushed out of the market. 

According to CoinGlass data, the altcoin saw $1.4 million worth of shorts liquidated. Usually, when shorts are liquidated, it creates new buying pressure, pushing the price higher and triggering more short liquidations. 

In addition to buying pressure arising from short exits, more funds were allocated to open new positions. Notably, the altcoin’s Open Interest (OI) surged 45% to $142 million as of writing. 

The OI surge was backed by a 110% jump in volume, reflecting high participation and capital inflows. 

Investors on Binance increased capital deployment significantly. Over the past 24 hours, the Perps Buy Volume rose to 90 million compared to 89 million in Sell Volume. 

A higher buy volume indicated that more buy orders were executed during the period. 

Could profit takers threaten the rally?

While the pressure on the derivatives side turned to the upside, sellers on the spot became aggressive.  For example, on the 16th of October, Celestia’s Spot Netlow climbed to a record high of $2.2 million. 

Such an elevated Netflow implied that more tokens were deposited into exchanges than withdrawn.  Historically, higher exchange inflows have increased selling pressure, weakening market structure. 

Can the momentum hold?

Celestia’s upside momentum has strengthened significantly despite the recent profit realization. 

A look at the momentum indicators confirms this view. For instance, at the time of writing, the altcoin’s positive index of ADX rose to 31 while the negative index fell to 7. 

Rising +DI while the -DI declines indicated a strong upward momentum. Likewise, the Aroon line also validates this, with Aroon Up climbing to 100%. 

These indicators reflect sustained bullish pressure and signal a likely continuation of the trend. Thus, if these factors remain constant, Celestia will reclaim $0.70 and target $0.80, where the trend collapsed in November. 

However, if bulls fail to hold off profit-takers, the altcoin could retest $0.50.

Final summary

  • Celestia surged 28%, cleared key resistance, and reached an 11-month high of $0.71 before slightly retracing to $0.68.
  • TIA rallied, driven by strong speculative demand, but profit-taking could threaten these gains.

data.title: Up 11% after Coinbase, Deribit listing, can PONS breach $0.34 next?
data.description:
At press time, Pons [PONS] was up more than 11% in the last 24 hours after wiping out this week’s losses. In fact, it is now among the top trending tokens on the launchpad.

Pons and Cash Cat [CASHCAT] are the only tokens on Robinhood Chain that have a market cap of more than $100 million. The two rebounded after debuting on both Coinbase and Deribit exchanges.

PONS perps listed on Coinbase and Deribit

Both Coinbase and Deribit listed PONS perps on their markets in select jurisdictions, leading to high speculative trading. The tokens were offered at a 25x leverage.

For instance, Coinbase’s PONS/USD spot book did 5.1 million tokens in a few hours, which is roughly $1.80 million. All 30 PONS pools on Robinhood Chain did $27 million in volume.

Right now, V2 Graduated Pools hold 50.5% of the volume share, while V1 and V2 Bonding Curves hold 25.9% and 23.6%, respectively.

Additionally, the Open Interest (OI) of the token on Hyperliquid [HYPE] grew from $29.6 million to $33 million. This indicated that bulls were stacking the coin as the price was rising alongside the OI.

On the other hand, the OI of CASHCAT on the same exchange was $23.50 million.

However, the main catalyst remains support from Robinhood Chain, with CEO Vlad Tenev telling builders,

You matter to us.

The evidence is clear: The chain retained 94% of the spot flow, even though the listing was the main event. Such support could help the launchpad token recover. Especially as buybacks have dropped by 90%.

Here, it’s worth noting that the platforms are giving early investors more distribution. These buyers put in $27.6 million, but they now hold just $1.66 million.

PONS attempts falling wedge breakout

On the 4-hour chart, the altcoin was still 64% below its all-time high (ATH) at press time. Its price was attempting to break through the upper resistance of the massive month-long falling wedge pattern at $0.3454.

The bullish resurgence was also evidenced by the Bull Bear Power turning green, despite the weak momentum. The RSI at 53.96 also broke above the neutral level, reinforcing the return of market buyers.

Therefore, breaking above the resistance would confirm the start of a recovery. Conversely, if the level is not breached, the crypto will face significant bearish pressure as price movements contract. Usually, contraction precedes expansion.

Final Summary

  • PONS rallied by more than 11% amid its listing on Coinbase and Deribit, sparking speculative trading. 
  • PONS was nearing a falling wedge pattern breakout as bulls slowly returned despite early investors exiting.
